question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party apparatus, military leadership, and security services as he prepares to secure a fourth term at the 2027 Party Congress. Recent developments, including purges of senior officials and reliance on trusted allies such as Cai Qi for elite recruitment, have reinforced his dominance without signs of organized internal challenge. Trader consensus at 95.5% against his removal before 2027 reflects the absence of visible succession mechanisms or rival power centers, alongside structural barriers like extensive surveillance and party discipline. Realistic scenarios that could still shift outcomes include a sudden health event, acute economic crisis sparking elite fractures, or an unforeseen military setback, though these remain low-probability based on current evidence.
